text.p: Here are the highlights of stories in the Danish press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
--- The Danish telecommunications group, Tele Danmark has joined the fight to win the order for the establishment and running of a future GSM mobile telephone net in Rumania.

--- The association of local authorities in Denmark is to debate whether to move local biker groups from densely populated areas in consequence of the car bombings which are connected to the ongoing biker war between the Hells Angels and Bandidos gangs in Scandinavia.
--- The Danish shipping group A.P. Moeller is to invest three billion crowns in adapting tankers to serve as floating production plants for oil and gas fields.

--- The 1995/96 season turnover of Danish Fur Auctions amounted to three billion crowns, double the previous 12-month period. The largest importers of Danish furs are China, Hong Kong, Korea, Japan and Russia.
--- Scandinavian Airlines System, SAS, has not yet decided whether to follow British Airways and the Dutch airline KLM in their newly started price war on flights to the U.S.A and Canada.
--- The British airline company Virgin Express is considering establishing a Scandinavian headquarters in Copenhagen with about ten routes to the other Scandinavian Countries.
